gw_pending.done.failed: could not restore — see the event feed
gw_pending.done.later: too early — the timer is set for the rest
gw_pending.done.nothing: no wait — confirmed or restored already
gw_pending.done.retry: the lock is busy — again in 30 s
gw_pending.err.busy: Confirm or revert the previous settings first: {what} waits for a confirmation for {left} more s.
gw_pending.err.busy_now: Wait for the rollback first: {what} was not confirmed, the old settings are being restored now.
gw_pending.err.gone: Too late: the settings were already reverted — the previous ones work.
gw_pending.err.locked: Another apply of settings is still running — try again in a minute.
gw_pending.err.no_undo: Safe apply is not available: the old settings of {what} are not recorded, so there is nothing to restore. Nothing was changed.
gw_pending.err.no_undo_hit: Not applied: you are connected through {what} — the link may drop, and the old settings could not be restored in 2 min: they are not recorded. Nothing was changed.
gw_pending.err.order: Program error: the wait lock was taken after the state lock.
gw_pending.err.preview_device: Pick a device: it cannot be found by the address of the connection.
gw_pending.err.preview_field: The preview of the new settings knows only the port for now.
gw_pending.err.timer: Could not turn on the safe apply: the revert timer was not set. Nothing was changed.
gw_pending.err.token: Bad wait code: 16 hex digits are needed.
gw_pending.event.failed: Could not revert the {what} settings. Open the panel and check the protocol settings
gw_pending.event.failed_base: Could not revert the gateway network. Open the panel: Settings › Gateway › Gateway network
gw_pending.event.failed_base_busy: Could not revert the gateway network: something on the server (Docker, another VPN) holds the previous network now. Open the panel: Settings › Gateway › Gateway network
gw_pending.event.failed_changed: The {what} settings were not reverted: they were changed again after the apply
gw_pending.event.failed_changed_base: The gateway network was not reverted: it was changed again after the apply
gw_pending.event.failed_port: Could not revert the {what} settings: port {port} is busy. Open the panel and pick another port
gw_pending.event.reverted: The {what} settings were reverted: no confirmation within 2 min
gw_pending.event.reverted_base: The gateway network was reverted: no confirmation within 2 min
gw_pending.help.confirm: keep the new settings — otherwise they revert by themselves in 2 min
gw_pending.help.expire: the revert by the timer (systemd calls it)
gw_pending.help.pending: safe apply: confirm the new settings (new things — in the panel; the CLI is for the menu and tests)
gw_pending.hit.base: You are connected through the gateway network: the link may drop after the change. If you do not confirm within 2 min, the settings go back by themselves.
gw_pending.hit.pool: You are connected through {what}: the link may drop after the change. If you do not confirm within 2 min, the settings go back by themselves.
gw_pending.log.preview: GW issue preview: {name} ({id}) — {kind} for {os}, the new settings are not applied yet
